card.name: Mid-item pieces in lists and cross-references
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside structured text: the letters O or D in a list of number bases, the digit after '1' in section cross-references like (12.3), and the 'onic' ending of tonic-clonic.

modes.label: Base code letters
modes.description: Letter codes in a list of integer base options such as binary, octal and decimal.
modes.example: #B-- the integer is written in binary (base 2) #<<O>>-- the integer is written in octal

modes.label: Section number digits
modes.description: Second digit of a section number inside a bracketed cross-reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Tonic-clonic ending
modes.description: The 'onic' ending of 'clonic' in 'generalized tonic-clonic seizures'.
modes.example: primary generalized tonic-cl<<onic>> seizures is 50 mg twice daily

card.plain: It fires on small pieces in the middle of codes, section numbers and the term tonic-clonic, where the next piece is predictable.
